# Native synthetic startup trace

`startup-native.json` was produced by `tools/verify_snowblind_startup.py` from
US BO3NETGM.ELF SHA-256
`00f19fd1c63f395ec6e3dfe1736c0a9c80e63becf4497d43a5fe095169ddc8c3`.
It contains only synthetic manifest data, addresses and state numbers; no game
code or assets. The HTTP response test compares its body with this trace.

The harness executes the retail manifest line parser and update state decisions.
HTTP completion, UI, local file lookup/cleanup and libc atoi are hooked. EE
low-word register saves/loads and pointer arithmetic are translated for MIPS32.
Inputs model no installed local patch and no `forcedownload` flag. This is not
a complete emulation of startup, filesystem behavior, HTTP handling or retail
transport selection.

Regenerate after extracting the supported disc:

```sh
python tools/verify_snowblind_startup.py
cp work/snowblind/startup-native.json internal/games/snowblind/testdata/startup-native.json
```

`friends-native.json` contains six synthetic incoming/outgoing/accepted friend
row writer/reader traces, online and offline, from
`tools/verify_snowblind_friends.py`. The row has no TTL-only online integer or
trailing preference bool. All names and IDs in the fixture are synthetic.
The harness also executes the native alert predicate with SDK list operations
hooked: incoming invitations trigger it; outgoing/accepted rows do not.

`clans-native.json` contains synthetic ClanDesc, alert and founder-member field
traces, a creation request and online/offline FetchMyClanDesc replies assembled from
the native field codecs. `tools/verify_snowblind_clans.py` runs both writer and
reader routines with SDK primitives and empty-list cleanup hooked. There are no
real clan names, account records or executable bytes in the fixture. The notice
trace checks native author/body writer/reader order, and the fixture includes a
populated notice-board FetchMyClanDesc reply. Invitation writer/reader traces
cover tag/name/inviter/rank/member count/recipient/active fields, and a complete
CheckMyInvitations reply includes incoming/outgoing lists plus own MemberData.
The third member flag is the invitation-acceptance preference; the final flag
is transient online presence.

`stats-native.json` contains a synthetic StatsRow traced through the retail
writer and menu consumer by `tools/verify_snowblind_stats.py`. It verifies the
two Strings/PID/float-list layout, rank, K/D and W/L, including the native
zero-death and unranked branches, with SDK/string helpers hooked.

`ranking-retail.json` contains only the public `Ranking` registration arguments
from the successful 2026-11-23 US retail startup. Extraction required exact
byte equality with the synthetic BO3Stats record: zero input IDs/owner/host,
policy 2, argument 32, flags 1, zero state/participant limits, BO3Stats description
and name, empty columns. No account name, password/hash, profile, ticket,
connection cookie or other capture content is included.

`gathering-native.json` was generated by `tools/verify_snowblind_gathering.py`
using synthetic BO3Match fields. It traces native writer 0x15dd10 and reader
0x15dd88 through the SDK primitive hooks, verifies all 16 fields and native
reader symmetry, and records no executable bytes. The Go codec is compared to
its field body. Any/Data envelopes and peer traffic are outside that native
field-codec test.


`nat-native.json` contains a synthetic payload executed through native NAT
writer `0x35c6a0` and reader `0x35c7d0` by `tools/verify_snowblind_nat.py`, using
the same private ELF and low-word EE translations as the other harnesses. SDK
address/buffer/clock/send helpers are hooked. It confirms kind, RVCID and timing
field widths/offsets; it does not claim native complete-UDP checksum execution.
All timestamps, identifiers and payload values are synthetic.


The clan native fixture also includes the Officer member codec and a complete
two-member FetchMyClanDesc response for the promoted player. Its leader bool
is false, Officer bool true, invitation-acceptance bool true, and online flag
false. This is generated by the same native writer/reader harness; Go tests
compare the promoted roster and own-member records byte for byte.
